title: Drive authorized work to completion without routine human checkpoints
requirements: Document that an accepted, sufficiently specified task pre-authorizes its full safe and reversible lifecycle; routine analysis, implementation, testing, fixes, validation, self-review, reconcile and completion do not need user checkpoints.
Document concrete escalation conditions, the diagnose-fix-revalidate-rereview recovery loop, and an honest self-review rule for a single Codex executor without requiring extra agents.

Add a controller drive command that applies only deterministic lifecycle transitions and reports the next Codex responsibility; it must retain dependency, lock, scope, validation, review, reconcile and finish safeguards and must not execute implementation or fabricate review evidence.
Add regression coverage for the drive command and autonomous-policy documentation; update the command reference and a complete autonomous lifecycle example.
acceptance: A new Codex session has unambiguous repository instructions to complete an authorized task or report one concrete true blocker.
drive advances only safe controller transitions and never finishes without a current PASS review or bypasses scope and dependency checks.
Pipeline regressions and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: The user explicitly authorized a minimal, safeguards-preserving autonomy improvement to the existing pipeline.
